title: ITW Reports First Quarter 2026 Results
body_markdown:
> GLENVIEW, ILL., July 28, 2026


“Our results reflect a meaningful acceleration in our capex-related segments, led by double-digit organic growth in Welding and Test & Measurement and Electronics, alongside strong performance in Polymers & Fluids. As we advance our enterprise strategy priorities, we remain well-positioned to drive consistent, above-market organic growth powered by increased contribution to revenue growth from Customer-Back Innovation while further expanding profitability and margins".


- Christopher O'Herlihy, President and Chief Executive Officer


View the complete[Press Release](https://s204.q4cdn.com/218186261/files/doc_financials/2026/q2/ITW-Reports-Second-Quarter-2026-Results.pdf)
